title: The Two Seals of Gideon
summary: In the walled Imperial-style seat of Gideon, Lukiul townsfolk and An-Xileel wardens clash over the Old Governor's Vaults when flood-levee sluice-keys and charter grants are forged.

hook.rumour: Someone opened the old Imperial flood-sluices above Gideon's rice levees in the dead of night, and both the Lukiul merchants and An-Xileel wardens are blaming each other.
hook.notice: GIDEON COURTHOUSE & LEVEE WATCH: Investigators wanted to inspect the Old Governor's Vaults and recover the bronze sluice-wheel charter.

npcs.name: Warden of Gideon
npcs.greet: Someone opened the old Imperial flood-sluices above Gideon's rice levees in the dead of night, and both the Lukiul merchants and An-Xileel wardens are blaming each other.
talk: The trouble across Gideon began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Gideon.
If you mean to help the Walled Seat of Gideon, start by checking the trail between Gideon and The Stable Steed.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Gideon
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at The Stable Steed is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from The Stable Steed toward Twyllbek Ruins before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Gideon so Magistrate Keshu-Verrus can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Twyllbek Ruins
npcs.greet: You made good time from The Stable Steed. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Gideon Courthouse.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Gideon Courthouse with a picked guard.
Once Gideon Courthouse is cleared, return to Gideon to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Gideon
npcs.greet: Magistrate Keshu-Verrus awaits word on whether the crisis in Gideon has been contained.
talk: The elders of Gideon have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Gideon owes you a debt for standing between Gideon and ruin.
